name: kaki-rally
description: A standalone Kaki racing game with rally, drift, stock, track drawing, Monster Smash, Trials, and a WebGL Catastrophe beta.

scripts.test: npm run test:renderer && npm run test:racing && npm run test:standalone && npm run test:assets
scripts.test:racing: node tools/smoke-rally-availability.mjs && node tools/smoke-racing-cameras.mjs && node tools/smoke-racing-physics.mjs && node tools/smoke-racing-tracks.mjs && node tools/smoke-racing-draw-track.mjs && node tools/smoke-racing-monster.mjs && node tools/smoke-monster-arena.mjs && node tools/smoke-monster-vehicle-physics.mjs && node tools/smoke-monster-records.mjs && node tools/smoke-racing-trials.mjs && npm run test:racing:crash && node tools/smoke-racing-visuals.mjs && node tools/smoke-racing-lifecycle.mjs
scripts.test:standalone: node tools/smoke-rally-save.mjs && node tools/smoke-standalone-boundaries.mjs && node tools/smoke-standalone-lifecycle.mjs

author: Daniel Knos
